findings.message: The initial peroxide charge is a 30% solution in water, not unspecified H2O2. Preserve that formulation in the reagent identity.

findings.quote: The aqueous and organic layers were partitioned and the organic layer was washed with H2O (1 x 30 mL) and brine (1 x 30 mL), then dried (MgSO4)
findings.message: The organic phase is retained through the initial separation and both washes. Unknown top/bottom position does not make its phase identity unknown.

findings.quote: then dried (MgSO4), filtered and the solvent removed under vacuum to leave a crude oil
findings.message: The filtrate is carried forward to solvent removal; the Filter step should identify the retained stream.
The eluent composition appears in evidence but is not represented operationally. Since Purify has no eluent field, preserve this condition in unmapped_actions.
